name: uContact
description_en:
uContact is net2phone’s cloud contact-centre platform for inbound,outbound and blended voice work plus optional omnichannel handling. The assigned integraccs.com address actually redirected to the current uContact page,and net2phone’s official history identifies its2022Integra CCS acquisition and uContact launch. This establishes the current product identity without treating Unite,Call Center Essentials,AI Agent and Coach AI as the same entitlement.

An illustrative service team could route a caller by IVR/skill,offer hold or callback,use a shared customer record,and finish with a disposition and wrap-up. Omni adds digital conversations and channel automation. Exact callback retries,CRM write guarantees and AI usage still require the chosen configuration and contract. No account,call,workflow,bot,CRM connection,screen recording,payment,POC or export was executed.
description_zh:
uContact是net2phone云联络中心，处理呼入、外呼及混合语音，并可选全渠道。指定integraccs.com实际跳转当前uContact页，net2phone官方历史也记2022年收购Integra CCS并推出uContact，据此建立当前产品身份，但不将Unite、Call Center Essentials、AI Agent及Coach AI当同一权益。

假设服务团队可按IVR／技能路由，提供等待或回拨，用共享客户记录，并以处置和整理结束；Omni加数字会话及渠道自动化。具体回拨重试、CRM写入保证和AI用量仍需所选配置及合同。未执行账户、电话、流程、机器人、CRM、屏幕录制、付款、POC或导出。

core_features.explanation_zh: Voice提供电话／路由／拨号，Omni加统一数字收件箱、WhatsApp／短信、邮件／网页聊天及劳动力功能。

core_features.explanation_zh: 监听／耳语／介入、复核多渠道录制，并设整理或自定义休息。

core_features.explanation_en: Use inbound/outbound campaigns,dialers,skills,priority and availability views within the selected edition.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在所选版本使用呼入／外呼活动、拨号器、技能、优先级及可用状态。

en: A support operation joining voice/digital context with IVR,queues and human follow-up.
An outbound team comparing a voice edition with a longer-term omnichannel package and separately priced AI tools.

steps.en: Verify callback/CRM results,report exports and retention before scaling;save required Content before the30daypost-term export window ends.
steps.zh: 扩量前核对回拨／CRM结果、报表导出及留存，在结束后30天导出窗口前保存所需内容。

items.zh: CCaaS条款要求独立用户凭据并禁止存卡资料，其他支付相关产品不能覆盖此边界。

sections.title_en: Follow the verified product identity to net2phone uContact
sections.title_zh: 沿已核身份链转到net2phone uContact
sections.en:
The assigned integraccs.com homepage actually redirected over ordinary HTTPS to net2phone’s named uContact product page. The company’s official timeline says it acquired Integra CCS in2022and launched uContact. The canonical product website and identity domain are therefore updated while the existing catalog slug remains unchanged. This is a documented identity bridge,not a guess from similar branding.

net2phone separately offers Unite,Call Center Essentials,AI Agent and Coach AI. A capability or price elsewhere in that portfolio does not automatically belong to uContact. This profile describes the current native cloud-contact-centre product and its dedicated Voice/Omni pricing section;no old on-premise contract or migration entitlement is assumed.
sections.zh:
指定integraccs.com主页经普通HTTPS实际跳到net2phone具名uContact产品页，公司官方历史称2022年收购Integra CCS并推出uContact。因此更新权威产品网址及身份域，保留已有slug。这是有文档身份桥，不是凭品牌相似猜测。

net2phone另售Unite、Call Center Essentials、AI Agent及Coach AI，其他产品功能或价不自动属uContact。本档案描述当前原生云联络中心及独立Voice／Omni定价，不假设旧本地合同或迁移权益。

sections.title_en: Configure the queue and confirm the resulting customer work
sections.title_zh: 配置队列并确认客户工作结果
sections.en:
uContact describes inbound,outbound and blended campaigns with ACD,IVR,dialers,recordings and a softphone. The automation page gives a more concrete flow:collect voice/key input,use customer data,route by skill/location/language/priority,and let callers wait or request a callback. Queue views show availability and estimated waits;these are operating controls,not guarantees that an agent will always be available.

For an illustrative service case,test a closed-hours branch,no matching skill,a full queue and an unanswered callback. Confirm the saved disposition and any external CRM update,not just that a call ended. Exact callback retries,timeout branches,record matching and write-back recovery were not established in the reviewed product pages. Predictive/progressive/power/preview labels do not supply a verified pacing or abandonment contract.
sections.zh:
uContact描述呼入、外呼及混合活动，含ACD、IVR、拨号器、录音和软电话。自动化页更具体：收语音／按键输入，用客户资料，按技能／地点／语言／优先路由，允许等待或预约回拨；队列显示可用性和预计等待。这些是运营控制，不保证一直有客服。

假设案例应测非工作时间、无匹配技能、满队列和回拨无人接，确认保存处置及外部CRM更新，不能只看电话结束。具体回拨重试、超时分支、身份匹配及回写恢复未由已读产品页建立，预测／渐进／Power／预览标签不提供已核节奏或弃接契约。

sections.title_en: Low-code tools still need authorized integrations and failure paths
sections.title_zh: 低代码工具仍需授权集成及失败路径
sections.en:
The native bot and Workflow Designer pages describe visual drag-and-drop construction with low-code skills. Bots can operate on WhatsApp,Facebook/Instagram,webchat and SMS,while integrations connect CRM data and subsequent tasks. This is more specific than a general automation label,but does not establish that every backend connection needs no development or professional services. The contract explicitly allows scoped,time-and-materials implementation work.

For an illustrative missed-call workflow,define the trigger,contact match,allowed channel,follow-up action and the system confirming success. Test an unauthorized request,expired connector credential,duplicate event and failed write. A chatbot saying a transaction completed is not a backend receipt. Native bots also do not establish that separately priced AI Agent/Coach AI credits are included in the uContact seat. No bot,API or transaction was run.
sections.zh:
原生机器人及Workflow Designer描述拖放可视设计，并需低代码技能。机器人可在WhatsApp、Facebook／Instagram、网页聊天及短信运行，集成连接CRM及后续任务。这比泛自动化具体，但不建立所有后端连接都无需开发或实施，合同明确允许按范围、工时材料收费。

假设未接工作流应定义触发、联系人匹配、获准渠道、跟进动作及确认成功系统，测试未授权请求、凭据过期、重复事件及写入失败。机器人说事务完成不是后端回执；原生机器人也不证明独立AI Agent／Coach AI余额含在座席。未运行机器人、API或事务。

sections.title_en: Distinguish live coaching,recordings and workforce claims
sections.title_zh: 区分实时指导、录制及劳动力主张
sections.en:
The workforce product section describes multichannel recording,client/supervisor ratings,private whisper coaching,call barging and agent wrap-up/custom breaks. Wrap-up gives time for notes and follow-up before the next interaction. These are concrete agent-support controls;the generic workforce-management essay on the same page is not proof that every forecasting or scheduling algorithm is included and configured.

Supervisor access to audio,screens and customer context needs permission and recording-consent checks. CCaaS terms prohibit storing cardholder data and require unique user credentials. COPC-quality models or HIPAA-compatible marketing are not an independent certification of the customer’s implementation. Report PDF/XLS/CSV export is listed in pricing,but complete recording,contact and workflow portability is still untested.
sections.zh:
劳动力产品部分描述多渠道录制、客户／主管评分、私下耳语、介入及整理／自定义休息，整理时间用于下一互动前备注和跟进。这些是具体客服控制，同页一般WFM文章却不证明每种预测或排班算法均包含并配置。

主管访问音频、屏幕及客户上下文需权限及录音许可检查。CCaaS条款禁止存卡资料，要求独立凭据；COPC模型或HIPAA兼容宣传不是客户实施独立认证。价格页列PDF／XLS／CSV报表导出，但完整录音、联系人及流程可携性未测。

sections.title_en: Monthly payment carries a36month pricing condition
sections.title_zh: 月付带有36个月价格条件
sections.en:
The uContact pricing section publishes Voice59.99and Omni84.99per user/month,with paid-monthly wording and a footnote that pricing is based on a36monthterm agreement. Voice lists campaigns,ACD,dialers,IVR,roles and reporting. Omni adds the unified digital inbox,social,SMS/WhatsApp,bots,email/webchat and workforce management. A customized proposal or free proof of concept is offered,but trial duration,capacity,actual ISO currency and a complete telecom/AI quote were not established.

The product page advertises24/7expert support,while the native CCaaS terms say8x5support is free and24x7support costs extra under the quote. Preserve this conflict rather than promise round-the-clock support at the seat price. AI Agent/Coach AI credit packages elsewhere on the pricing page use different units and are not merged into uContact costs. Setup,carrier,storage,connector and exit charges still need the actual regional agreement.
sections.zh:
uContact价格节公开Voice59.99及Omni84.99，每用户每月，写按月付，但脚注价格基于36个月协议。Voice列活动、ACD、拨号器、IVR、角色及报表，Omni加数字收件箱、社交、短信／WhatsApp、机器人、邮件／聊天及WFM。可定制提案或免费概念验证，但试用期、容量、ISO币种及完整电话／AI报价未建立。

产品页宣传24／7专家支持，原生CCaaS条款却称8×5免费、24×7按报价另付。保留冲突，不承诺座席价含全天支持。同价页其他AI Agent／Coach AI余额包单位不同，不混uContact成本。设置、运营商、存储、连接器及退出费仍需真实地区协议。

sections.title_en: Use native CCaaS terms and preserve the30day export window
sections.title_zh: 使用原生CCaaS条款并保留30天导出窗口
sections.en:
The July2026terms’Section32specifically governs native call/contact-centre services and takes precedence over conflicting general provisions. General restrictions on autodialing explicitly exempt lawful CCaaS use under its conditions;do not apply an unrelated UCaaS ban or third-party Five9 agreement to this product. The CCaaS license is limited,revocable,nontransferable and does not transfer software ownership. Third-party services have their own terms,data access and availability risks.

Content can be exported during the service term and for30days after it ends,including from an early termination date;afterward the vendor may delete it. This is a contractual window,not proof of complete export,restore or continued normal service. uContact is an editorial candidate for teams able to own routing,workflow permissions,supervision,contract commitments and exit records. Actual callback/CRM failure behavior,retention,AI rates,regions,UI languages and measured uptime remain unverified.
sections.zh:
2026年七月条款第32节专门管原生呼叫／联络中心，优先于冲突通用规定。通用自动拨号限制明确豁免符合条件合法CCaaS用法，不能把无关UCaaS禁令或第三方Five9协议套此产品。CCaaS许可有限、可撤销、不可转移，不转软件所有权；第三方服务另有条款、资料访问及可用性风险。

服务期及结束后30天可导出Content，提前终止也从终止日起算，之后厂商可删除。这是合同窗口，不证明完整导出、恢复或正常持续服务。编辑判断适合能负责路由、流程权限、监管、合同承诺及退出资料的团队。真实回拨／CRM失败、留存、AI费、地区、界面语言及实测可用性未核。
